commits.message:
perf(lammps): make repeated atom identity validation linear time

Retain the original wrapping, neighbor rebuild and metadata contracts. Add independent LJ/force checks and an alternating-round profiler for boundary-aligned and translated large-system batches.

feat(openmm): add exact fixed-cell RPMD copy evaluation

Keep all rows in one unstepped copy bank, return physical PES forces, and validate virtual-site copy selection. Reject constraints and changed cells explicitly, preserve serial metadata, and add Reference/finite-difference/restart checks plus a CUDA-ready timing matrix.

bench: add strict CUDA provider and public workflow validation matrix

Record CPU float64 references, synchronized timings, caller-stream checks, actual imported sources and explicit blocked cases. Validate complete public-workflow work before timing summaries, support isolated framework environments, and never claim physical or CUDA acceptance from CPU-only evidence.
